steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.

args.goal: select the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB product so Product Variant becomes Default Variant, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), configure Savings for the product using Last Purchase Price, save the savings configuration, and stop on the create screen ready to publish

steps.note: Perform the product variant, delivery location, and Last Purchase Price savings interactions not covered by dedicated domain steps.
Invite one QA vendor so the event can be published and bid on.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit a bid so savings can be calculated from a completed response.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the event before inspecting post-bid results.
Open Master QCS after bidding has ended, as required by the scenario.
Navigate to Price Trends where the last-purchase-price savings result is displayed.

args.goal: verify that Price Trends shows the event's savings calculated against Last Purchase Price for the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB product

steps.note: Verify the savings basis and calculated result on the buyer screen.
Assert that the expected savings basis is visibly identified.
